jobs_results.description:
Como parte de Ayesa, conformamos uno de los principales conglomerados de servicios de Ingeniería y Tecnologías de la Información (TIC) del mercado.

Somos más de personas en más de 20 países de Europa, América, África y Asia y contamos con el reconocimiento de Forbes como una de las 50 mejores empresas para trabajar.

Resulta gratificante comprobar cómo nuestro trabajo, apoyado en la tecnología, ayuda a personas y organizaciones a superar retos y conseguir objetivos.
Si tú también quieres contribuir a estos cambios y experimentar esta sensación especial, acércate y ven a formar parte de este gran equipo
DESCRIPCIÓN
• Estará muy ligado a los equipos de desarrollo, ya que tiene que colaborar activamente en el cambio de mentalidad de los desarrolladores.Va a tener que ayudar y facilitar a los desarrolladores a montar sus test de pruebas, tener claros los diferentes tipos de test (unitarios, de integración, de regresión, end to end, de entendimiento...)Va tener que estar con el equipo de... desarrollo y, en algunos casos, montar los test unitarios con ellos y ayudarles.
REQUISITOS
Tester con experiencia en herramientas , selenium, gherkin/cucumberExperiencia en el diseño y ejecución de prueba unitarias con capacidad de valorar la calidad de la pruebas unitarias de los equipos

jobs_results.title: Senior Quality Assurance Tester
jobs_results.description:
Cuidar de las personas y empresas para hacer del mundo un lugar más seguro, manteniéndonos a la vanguardia de la innovación es lo que nos motiva desde hace más de 40 años.

Y lo hacemos utilizando las tecnologías más punteras (IA, IoT, Data Science, Blockchange, etc.) para ofrecer soluciones disruptivas a través de nuestras cinco líneas de negocio : Security, Cash, Alarms, Cipher y AVOS.

Como un verdadero equipo, nuestros más de 150.000 profesionales han conseguido posicionarnos como un referente a nivel global en el sector de la seguridad privada estando presentes en más de 25 países.

La innovación y la capacidad para transformarnos forman parte de nuestro ADN y compartimos tres valores que nos caracterizan : Nos importan las personas, pensamos en positivo y somos imparables.

Cipher es una empresa global de ciberseguridad que presta una amplia variedad de servicios. Entre sus clientes se encuentran desde empresas de tamaño medio hasta empresas de fama internacional y agencias... gubernamentales, con innumerables casos de éxito.

Y tú? Te sientes identificado con nuestro propósito? Te apasionan los retos y quieres llevar tu carrera profesional a otro nivel?

Hoy tienes la oportunidad de hacerlo sumándote a nuestro Team of Teams como Q&A.

Necesitamos una persona con inquietudes técnicas, que le guste estar siempre actualizado en las tendencias del mercado y nuevas soluciones de ciberseguridad.
• Resolución de incidencias derivadas a la calidad del producto.
• Administración de herrramientas de test automatizado como Selenium, Jira, Testrail
• Automatización de pruebas
• Gestión y administración de casos de usos.
• Reporting y documentación de los problemas en detalle.
• Evaluación de capacidad, velocidad y carga de las plataformas

Qué buscamos de ti?
• Capacidades de atención al detalle : Importante para identificar errores minuciosos.
• Actitudes como la Comunicación efectiva : Para informar problemas de manera clara.
• Habilidades de resolución de problemas : Analizar y abordar desafíos.
• Conocimientos Herramientas de pruebas : Conocimiento de herramientas como Selenium, JIRA, TestRail, etc.
• Experiencia Automatización de pruebas : Desarrollo y ejecución de scripts.
• Actitudes Metodologías de desarrollo : Comprender Agile, Scrum u otras metodologías.
• Conocimientos Lenguajes de programación : Conocimiento de Python, o JavaScript.
• Experiencia Gestión de casos de prueba : Crear y mantener casos detallados.
• Capacidad de Identificación y reporte de defectos : Documentar problemas con precisión.
• Uso en el uso de bases de datos : Trabajar con bases de datos y ejecutar consultas PostgreSQL.
• Experiencia en pruebas de rendimiento, seguridad y carga : Evaluar capacidad y velocidad del producto bajo carga.
• Buenas habilidades de depuración : Investigar y resolver problemas técnicos.
• Conocimientos en el Control de versiones : Familiaridad con sistemas como Git y AzureDevOps

Qué te ofrecemos?
• Formar parte de un equipo internacional.
• Teletrabajo 100%.
• Trabajar en un entorno dinámico con un excelente ambiente laboral.
• Crecer profesionalmente atendiendo a un plan carrera personalizado.
• Acceder a un plan formativo de primer nivel gracias a la Universidad Corporativa de Prosegur
• Disponer de flexibilidad horaria, teletrabajo e interesantes beneficios sociales ( Retribución flexible, beneficios corporativos, cashback..)
• Disfrutar de nuestro Programa Global de Bienestar.
• Participar en proyectos estratégicos y disruptivo.
• Colaborar con nuestra Fundación para crear una sociedad más justa.
• Dar vida a tus ideas en nuestro Programa Global de Innovación e Intraemprendimiento

jobs_results.title: Tester
jobs_results.description:
Based in Madrid or Milan and reporting to the Market Facing Platform Manager. This role requires someone flexible, adaptable that can take ownership of his tasks/work and focused on providing excellence in Software Quality Assurance and Testing. Strong technical and analytical skills, ability to think outside of the box and to communicate well at all levels of the business.

You'll conduct mainly manual tests to ensure the product created by developers is fit for purpose and passes the testing criteria and successes factors, as defined together with the business.

You will analyse and verify the best manual test approaches, ensuring that 'technical debt' is avoided, whilst estimating tests in terms of functionality, performance and coverage. You will also be executing acceptance, integration, installation and system testing, recording results and verifying software bug fixes.
• *Responsabilities**:
Accountable for Functional and System Integration Testing against previously defined... and signed-off business requirements, functional specifications or user stories

Accountable for the elaboration of test scenarios, test scripts and testing evidence to ensure those meet appropriate levels of control for quality, risk and audit purposes

Investigate complex issues identified and if appropriate raise as defects in JIRA, working with developers, BA's etc. to ensure timely resolution to all defects

Review and provide feedback on requirements and specifications to ensure that those are easy understood, unambiguous and testable

Drafting and presenting the end of test report highlighting key issues found during testing once the testing phase is complete

Actively contribute during sprint retrospectives

Focus on delivering business value through sound testing methods and principles

Contribute to drive forward testing standards and process
• *Qualifications**:
• *Essential Skills**:
Working within your project team, create Test Plans which will identify the test strategy, objectives, work flows and acceptance criteria outcomes for any given project.

Write end-to-end tests scenarios out of the user stories for users to be guided during acceptance testing.

Work with the Development team to capture and/or re-use automated test cases for non-regression release checks.

Author Test Reports which will contain detailed and unambiguous results of testing, and present to project team for consideration.

Conduct Manual and Automated Regression, Non-Regression and Integration testing on Websites and API's.

Perform a wide range of software testing techniques, including Stress, performance and Functional testing. Support the business in completing UAT and undertake such test when required
• *Professional Experience**:
Business level of English is a must

Good level of Spanish, Italian or French is desirable

Definition of positive, negative and boundary test cases for functional, non-functional and regression testing purposes

Strong SQL experience and ability to understand and query databases effectively

Test definition and execution

Can traverse System Testing, System Integration Testing and User Acceptance Testing understanding the different requirements of each discipline

Expertise in capturing and analyzing data and documenting test plans and tracking deliverables

Experience with Postman for API testing would be a plus
• *What we offer in return**:
12 months of FTC with possibility of permanent role

30 days of vacation a year

Working from home option

Life and accident insurance

Meal allowance

Gympass discount

Comprehensive Learning&Development support

Flexible Working

We are open to discussing flexible working arrangements. This can be discussed with the Recruitment Business Partner managing this position.

Integrity. Client Focus. Respect. Excellence. Teamwork

Our core values dictate how we live and work. We’re an ethical and honest company that’s wholly committed to its clients. A business that’s engaged in mutual trust and respect for its employees and partners. A place where colleagues perform at the highest levels. And a working environment that’s collaborative and supportive.

Diversity & Inclusion

jobs_results.description:
**:

- All CVs must be submitted in English -**
• *JOIN OUR QA STUDIO IN MADRID**

Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K's portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us 2K publishes titles in today's most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.

Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, problem solvers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically-acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, The... Darkness, Mafia, Sid Meier's Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM.

2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO).
• *_ JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:_**
- Support and perform tests on 2D and 3D games repeatedly, while listening and looking for bugs.
- Provide coaching, training, and overall guidance to QA Testers and Senior QA Testers.
- Create and develop test scripts based on business requirements and processes, aligned with defined workflows and use cases.
- Assist in developing, designing and ensuring the overall integrity of the testing strategy including disaster recovery and business continuity testing.
- Help design, develop and implement test plans including regression testing, scripts and tools utilizing documented business requirements and functional specifications.
- Coordinate adequate levels of testing documentation with the appropriate technical groups and/or pods by working with Lead/Manager to identify appropriate data for testing and prepare that data for the test cases.
- Assess and potentially revise testing strategies and cases based on project scope changes.
- Work with appropriate Leads to determine the acceptable range for test results and overall performance.
- Reconcile test results from different tests and different pods.
• *_ KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS_**_:_
- Exceptional communication and writing skills.
- Intermediate to advanced MS Office Excel, Word and Outlook skills.
- Advanced database skills; to include TTP and Jira.
- High productivity with few errors.
- Successful in leading a small or large pod.
- Demonstrates understanding and lives by the departments' core values with adherence to Company policies.
- Consistently provides a positive role-model to testers, in terms of work performance, attitude and attendance.
• *_ QUALIFICATIONS: _**
- Education and Experience: _
- High School diploma or equivalent.
- Minimum age of 18 years and above.
- 3+ years of QA testing experience.
- Comprehensive understanding of test cycles and processes.
- Reliable, and can be counted on to work all scheduled shifts.
- Must be able to communicate effectively in English, in both written and oral forms.

Do you really meet the requirements? Do not hesitate to apply We´re looking forward to meeting you

jobs_results.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs_results.description:
CHEP helps move more goods to more people, in more places than any other organization on earth via our 300 million pallets, crates and containers. We employ 11,000 people and operate in more than 55 countries. Through our pioneering and sustainable share-and-reuse business model, the world's biggest brands trust us to help them transport their goods more efficiently, safely and with less environmental impact.

What does that mean for you? You'll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner. You'll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You'll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals. And you can maximize your work-life balance and flexibility through our .

Job Description

The Senior Quality Assurance Engineer will work with the SCI teamto ensure the delivery of high-quality software products by implementing rigorous... testing processes and methodologies. They will play a critical role in software development lifecycle, collaborating closely with the team to identify, analyze, and mitigate risks to product quality. They will be key to ensuring our products are usable and accurate.

Responsibilities:
• Working with development team, product owners and other stakeholders across the business to deliver quality product.
• Performing exploratory testing on the application.
• Writing and executing manual test cases.
• Carrying out regression testing to ensure that software updates and enhancements do not adversely impact existing functionality.
• Coaching fellow QA members in test case creation.
• Becoming an expert on the product.
• Building a suite of automated tests for UI and API services.
• Encouraging test automation atappropriate levels.
• Building efficient pipelines and ensuring automated tests are run as part of the pipelines.
• Constantly working towards improving the release process.
• Using tools and techniques for monitoring infrastructure, application logs, metrics, and traces.

Experience
• At least 5 yearsof experience in software testing / quality assurance .
• Experience with web-based application testing.
• Experience testing Rest APIs using tools like tools like Postman or similar.
• Experience in UI automation using tools like Selenium, Cypress or Playwright.
• Experience in non-functional testing, including performance and security, using tools like JMeter, k6, or similar.
• Experience in writing basic SQL queries / joins for database testing.
• Experience in configuring CI/CD pipelines to run automated tests.
• Experience with AWS cloud computing services is a bonus.

Skills
• Knowledge of JavaScript.
• Be updated with latest testing tools and industry best practices.
• Ability to build testing infrastructure and set up automation framework from scratch.
• Ability to explore new tools and techniques and fill gaps in test automation.
• Ability to coach developers about quality to ensure shared understanding about quality expectations.
• Ability to coach and mentor fellow QA engineers in line with industry standards and best practices.
• Knowledge of DevOps principles.
• Very good communication skills (verbal and written).
• Fluency in English.

Preferred Education
Bachelors

Preferred Level of Work Experience
5 - 7 years

Remote Type
Hybrid Remote

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to developing a diverse workforce in which everyone is treated fairly, with respect, and has the opportunity to contribute to business success while realizing his or her potential. This means harnessing the unique skills and experience that each individual brings and we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class

jobs_results.description:
Software QA Automation Engineer page is loaded Software QA Automation Engineer
Apply locations EMEA - Poland - Kraków - Lubomirskiego time type Full time posted on Posted 16 Days Ago job requisition id 24WD75132

Job Requisition ID #
24WD75132

Position Overview

Become a member and participate in a varied, co-located Software Engineering Scrum team joining the Civil Infrastructure Product Line Group in Krakow as a junior QA Automation Engineer.

Your team develops Civil engineering software , like Autodesk Civil 3D and InfraWorks, to help civil engineers during both the design and construction process.

You are passionate and committed to working in an Agile team, have great attention to detail, approach the testing of desktop software using Javascript or C#, and can create and execute test strategies for the validation of complex software. You have a customer focus and the ability to drive quality in a predictable manner.

In this role, you will have a significant impact on how we... ensure the quality of our products for millions of professionals. You will report to the Engineering Manager and work in a cross-functional team focused on building and maintaining software for various products and components. You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of unique challenges which give you the chance to learn modern technology and grow your skills.

Your direct co-workers will be in Germany, Hungary, Spain, the US and Canada, while you will be working in a Hybrid model from our Krakow office location.

Responsibilities
• Support automated testing, create scripts to support automation testing. And also execute manual testing wherever required
• Analyze and decompose cross-product workflows and start designing a strategy to test them
• Support developing and executing high quality test plans to deliver an amazing user experience
• Support developing test strategies that are complete and concise
• Perform functional testing, regression testing, ongoing system integration, and periodic build verification tests as part of each product release cycle
• Find defects in features in development or products in production. Isolate, confirm, and log defects. Work with Agile Team to prioritize and fix them
• Actively participate in Agile ceremoniessuch as sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint retrospective etc.
• Work with the Agile team at improving Quality Assurance process and be an ambassador for automated quality
• Identify redundant tests scenarios and work on their automation

Minimum Qualifications
• 1-2 years experience with C# or C++ programming
• Passion to improve product quality
• Customer orientated approach to Quality Assurance
• Some experience in software development in a commercial setting in a Scrum team
• First or upper-second class degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
• Solid English knowledge

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in complex software solutions and code bases
• Experience with Javascript
• Experience with Git or similar source code revision control systems
• Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD pipeline and Test Automation
• Understanding of deployment methodology
• Working Experience or educational background in AEC industry is a plus

Tech that we use

C#, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, TestComplete, Node, Docker, Python, AWS, Artifactory, CMake, Jenkins

Learn More
